Question: Can we travel with a PNR number but without a counter ticket in the Indian railway?
Answer: Travelling with PNR no., message sent by IRCTC, printout, screenshot of ticket is allowed only for tickets booked online. If counter ticket is booked then it is mandatory to carry counter ticket during the journey. If you do not have counter ticket then you will be considered as ticketless passenger and fine will be taken accordingly. Few months back, My brother was travelling from Bhopal to Lucknow in Pushpak SF Exp. Tickets were not available so I booked a tatkal counter ticket here in Lucknow amd sent a picture of that ticket to him. I was thinking that it will be accepted as he has valid ID, Message sent by IRCTC and picture of ticket but TTE refused to consider anything as counter ticket is mandatory. I asked IRCTC and also reached officials through rail madad but nothing worked. At end , My brother had to pay a fine of INR 1340 ( base fare+ penalty). So, I highly recommend everyone to carry counter ticket if ticket is booked through counter. TTEs have chart and they know which passenger has e-ticket and counter ticket. Question: How good is the IRCTC app to book tickets?
Answer: IRCTC’s rail connect is an official application of IRCTC. It is a good option to book a ticket but it has some limitations like delay in refund (takes 3–7 working days) , no free cancellation feature, slow customer support. I personally use Confirmtkt application. They provide an instant refund and free cancellation feature as well. There is a small premium if you opt for free cancellation but it is below than cancellation charges of confirmed ticket in some cases. This works as same as flight booking’s full refund feature. You can also check their alternate train feature which helps you in finding trains from nearby stations if there is a waiting list at your station. There is a small agent fee of INR 19.99 ( approved by IRCTC) which i think is reasonable for such additional features. Infact, feature like waiting list prediction which is found on all applications now was innovated by the company confirmtkt. There are few more applications but i haven’t use them so can not suggest you as of now. Note: Confirmtkt is authorised from IRCTC so it is completely safe. Thank you.

Question: Can I take a general ticket and travel by chair car by standing?
Answer: Actually you should never do that because Chair car ( CC) is the most inconvinient class for unreserved passengers. You can not even ask for some berth to sit as there are chairs which are only for 1 person. If you have to travel urgently then go for classes like SL & 3AC. Note: Railways does not allow unreserved passengers to travel in reserved coaches. Doing so will result into a penality of INR 250 + Fare difference. Let me know if you need furthur clearification. Question: How can I extend the duration of usage for free WiFi at railway stations in India?
Answer: Free Wifi for 30 mins. is available at 5500+ railway stations in India but what if you have to wait their for more than 30 mins.? In India, trains usually run delayed by 1–4 hours and this delay has gone upto the record of 72 hours ( Himgiri Exp.) now here the importance of high speed internet goes to next level as only internet can be your partner to spend these waiting hours specially if you are alone. There is no special service provided to the passengers waiting for the train in terms of free wifi by the railways but there is a way through which you can enjoy free wifi service as long as you want . Recently, I was at Lucknow NR and my train was running late by 4 hours. It was expected to arrive at 03:00 so I decided to leave home at 23:00 hours and to wait at station. I checked my Internet connection was poor inside the railway station so I connected Free wifi by entering my mobile number and OTP which i received on my number . After 30 mins. I again entered my another number and the OTP came to that number. Again, After 30 mins. I entered my friend’s number and called him for the OTP. Similarly, I enjoyed the free wifi until my train has arrived. You can also enjoy the free wifi service as long as you want . Note: •Only Indian mobile numbers are allowed. •At few stations, free wifi is unlimited.
